name: Zerah
bio: Zerah is the other twin son born to Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar. He was the child who first put out his hand during delivery, marked by the midwife with a scarlet thread as the firstborn, but then drew his hand back, letting his brother Perez be born first instead — hence his name (Genesis 38:28-30). Zerah's descendants went on to form an important clan within the tribe of Judah, appearing repeatedly in the tribal genealogies recorded in Joshua and elsewhere.
